```{r}
tex <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("\\\\", "\\\\textbackslash{}", x, fixed = FALSE)
  x <- gsub("&",  "\\&",  x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("%",  "\\%",  x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("$",  "\\$",  x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("#",  "\\#",  x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("_",  "\\_",  x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("{",  "\\{",  x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("}",  "\\}",  x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("~",  "\\textasciitilde{}", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("^",  "\\textasciicircum{}", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x
}
```
